body: Adapting a single vision-language model to medical image parsing requires training choices that reflect the demands of each task. We study task-specific adaptation with Qwen3.5-9B for FLARE 2026 Task 3, covering six task families and seven imaging modalities. Our system couples a shared, frozen 4-bit backbone with LoRA adapters selected from the input question. We customize adapter ranks and prompts, rebalance rare classification targets, and supplement regression training with dermatology classification examples. On the fixed internal holdout, the task-specific adapters achieve a dataset-macro balanced accuracy of 0.7791 for classification, a dataset-macro micro-F1 of 0.6286 for multi-label classification, a counting mean absolute error (MAE) of 11.73, a dataset-macro detection F1 of 0.8914, a dataset-macro regression MAE of 9.78, and a report-generation CRIMSON score of 0.8204. On the organizer's 1,703-example hidden-validation set, the submitted system achieves 0.8496 classification balanced accuracy, 0.5338 sample-averaged multi-label F1, and 14.5950 regression MAE. The final 30.1 GB container averages 3.1 seconds per case, including model loading, and produces identical outputs across repeated verification runs. The benefits vary across tasks, supporting the use of task-specific adapter configurations and image budgets within a shared medical vision-language model. Code is available at https://github.com/TahaSabir0/FLARE26-Hexapus.
summaryZh: 本文探讨了如何通过任务特定的LoRA适配器，使单一视觉语言模型（Qwen3.5-9B）适应多种医学图像解析任务。研究通过冻结4-bit主干网络并结合针对不同任务定制的适配器，在FLARE 2026数据集上实现了显著的分类与回归性能提升。实验证明，任务特定的配置能有效平衡不同模态与任务的需求，为医学影像AI的部署提供了高效的优化方案。

模型中负责提取基础特征的核心神经网络架构。
在医学影像分析中用于预测连续数值（如病灶计数或尺寸）的任务。
